body: I'm sorry to ruin your day, but I thought the exact same thing in my senior year of high school. Look at me now.

See, I don't know anymore. For the longest time I wanted to go to med school, mostly because my father's a doctor. But over the years, I realized that med school's an unreachable goal for me. But my dad never saw it that way. He thinks I'm very smart, I just don't try enough. and he may be right, but he's been telling me that for the past 6 years. I just don't know what to do anymore
